name: Violence Into Verdure
summary: A caretaker asks you to plant enchanted seeds around the ruined war machines in Hyjal. New growth can cover the weapons and help the land recover from the war.

sections.title: Seeds for the Ruins
sections.body: The war machines lie ruined in Hyjal, and their old metal is rusting. You are given enchanted seeds gathered before, their growth hastened by a little magic. Plant them near the ruined ballista, catapult, and flying machine. There, plants can cover the weapons as the land begins to reclaim them.

faq.answer: You are planting enchanted seeds whose growth has been hastened by magic.
Plant the seeds near the ruined ballista, ruined catapult, and ruined flying machine.

faq.q: Why plant seeds around the weapons?
faq.answer: The plants can cover the old weapons and help return them to the soil.
The war was only a few years ago and left scars in Hyjal, including old war machinery.

attribution: In-game quest text: Violence Into Verdure
